title: IO Crest SY-ENC50128 5-Bay USB Type-C Hard Drive Enclosure
amazon_match_notes: Verified exact match: Woot ASIN B0FBZWDSL7 is the IO Crest / Syba SY-ENC50128 5-bay USB 3.2 Gen2 Type-C DAS enclosure, UPC 850039353437.

comparisons.notes: Syba SY-ENC50128, 5-bay USB 3.2 Gen2 Type-C, UPC 850039353437. In stock and matching.
MPN sy-enc50128, same 5-bay USB-C DAS enclosure. In stock and matching.

writeup: IO Crest's SY-ENC50128 5-bay USB-C DAS enclosure, also sold as Syba (UPC 850039353437), is a 10Gbps Type-C box with software RAID and a 120TB capacity cap. Woot has it new for $59.99. Newegg lists that same enclosure at $168.99, and Beach Audio has it at $193.89, so this is about 64% below Newegg, or roughly $109 off. Woot is showing 3+ left, with a limit of 3 per customer, and did not list a condition on the offer.
